content.what_it_is: MATLAB extraction script for the solitary-wave-on-plane-beach measured benchmark, case B. Loads four eta snapshots eta_0085/0101/0118/0132 (L6-14), row 2 of each as 1D profile (d1..d4). Non-dimensional coordinate x=(6000-(i-1)*dx)/dep with dx=5, dep=100 (L20-23). Keeps -10.0<=x<=20.0 (wider than the case-A window -2..20; L26-37), storing eta/dep in data columns 2-5 (L31-34), x into column 1 reversed (L38-42). Writes FUNWAVE_BP1B_SHAPE.txt tab-delimited precision 6 (L44).
entities: script variables: fdir @L2, dep @L4, d @L6 (reused), n @L7, d1..d4 @L8-14, dx @L20, x @L22, ii @L25, kk @L30, data @L31-41, ll @L38
unresolved: Case B keeps a wider window x>=-10 (L27) than case A (-2) -- larger runup excursion; snapshot indices 0085..0132 map to benchmark times externally.
Row 2 of each 2D snapshot as profile and length(d) as column count -- same assumptions as the A/analytical variants.
